function.name: bash
function.description: Execute bash commands in the terminal. Use this for running scripts, checking file contents, installing packages, and other command-line operations. Supports piping, redirection, and complex shell operations.

function.name: str_replace_editor
function.description: Custom editing tool for viewing, creating and editing files in plain-text format. State is persistent across command calls. Use this for reading files, creating new files, and making precise edits to existing code.

function.name: python
function.description: Execute Python code in an isolated environment. Useful for data analysis, calculations, and quick prototyping. Has access to common libraries like numpy, pandas, and matplotlib.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for current information, documentation, and answers to questions. Returns relevant snippets and URLs from search results.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file from the filesystem. Supports text files, JSON, YAML, and other common formats. Can read specific line ranges for large files.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file on the filesystem. Creates new files or overwrites existing ones. Automatically creates parent directories if they don't exist.

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List files and directories in a given path. Supports recursive listing and filtering by file extension or pattern.

function.name: git_operations
function.description: Perform git operations like commit, push, pull, branch, merge, and status. Helps manage version control workflows.

function.name: finish
function.description: Signal that the task is complete. Use this when you have successfully completed the user's request and are ready to end the session.
